items.label: FIGURE 2D.1
items.title: Relationship between income and consumption Ginis for countries with both

content.data_points: Multiple data points plotted as orange circles showing a positive correlation between consumption and income Gini indexes, with most points lying above the 45° line.
content.source: World Bank, Poverty and Inequality Platform (version September 2024), https://pip.worldbank.org.
content.note: Estimated relationship between income and consumption Gini indexes for countries that have surveys reporting both welfare aggregates in a given year.
